messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@oakbridge.com>, procurement@oakbridge.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly vector brief — QBR readiness (wins / risks / asks)

Team — running a condensed vector-style update ahead of next week’s QBR prep. Short bullets below; attached a compact readiness matrix and the one-pager for the cross-functional sprintboard.

Wins:
- Oakbridge POC: latency baseline validated on Redwood Dedicated (p95 < 120ms) for their 4k token workflow. Demo scheduled 4/25 with their ML lead.
- Batching improvements: initial rollout to two fleets reduced token cost by ~12% on production routes.
- Eval harness: automated regression checks added for top 6 prompts; false-positive rate dropped 40%.

Risks / Concerns:
- Model variant parity: quantized variant shows divergence on safety prompts for Oakbridge domain; mitigation requires a small rollback window and an extra eval run (estimated 6 engineer-hours).
- Capacity planning: Dedicated pool utilization projects hitting burst reserves in week-of-QBR if Oakbridge increases demo traffic — may require temporary burst allocation or routing to secondary pools.
- Deck readiness: Ops metrics (per-route token breakdown) missing from QBR deck; this will affect our cost narrative.

Asks / Requests:
1) Laura — can you confirm whether we have approval to provision +10% burst capacity for the week of 4/29? Need confirmation by EOD 4/23 to lock pricing.
2) Soojin — can you include the per-route token and latency chart in the QBR slide set (link below)? I can provide the raw CSV.
3) Team — please review the attached readiness matrix and add a named owner for each open mitigations item by EOD 4/24.

Attachments: Q2_readiness_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), vector-brief-2029-04-22.pdf (one-pager)
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQBR-prep

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
